## Visualization ray evaluation

```{r message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(stats)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
EXP_PATH = "/home/yl1118/Desktop/RANsim/exp7/"
```

Lode dataset

```{r load_data}
sla_vio = read.csv(paste0(EXP_PATH, "sla_vio_times.csv"))
reconf = read.csv(paste0(EXP_PATH, "reconf_times.csv"))
reward = read.csv(paste0(EXP_PATH, "reward.csv"))
```

Data process function

```{r}
process_data <- function(data, iteration_steps) {
  if (!is.numeric(iteration_steps) || iteration_steps <= 0) {
    stop("iteration_steps must be a positive integer")
  }

  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(evaluation = row_number() * iteration_steps) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      mean = mean(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = mean + 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation))))),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation)))))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(evaluation, mean, upper, lower)
  
  return(processed_data)
}
```

## Process sla_vio

```{r}
iteration_steps = 3000
```

## Process for my algorithm

```{r}
sla_vio_stats <- process_data(sla_vio, iteration_steps)
sla_vio_stats
```

```{r}
reconf_stats <- process_data(reconf, iteration_steps)
reconf_stats
```

```{r}
reward_stats <- process_data(reward, iteration_steps)
reward_stats
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
ggplot(reward_stats, aes(x = evaluation)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean), color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Evaluation of SLA Violations over Experiments",
       x = "Evaluation Number",
       y = "Mean SLA Violations") +
  theme_classic()
```
